properties.displayName: ImageMagick has an Infinite Loop in subimage-search with crafted image
properties.description: ImageMagick has an Infinite Loop in subimage-search with crafted image
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "imagemagick" or Msg contains "infinite" or message_s contains "imagemagick" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1760
